items.name: parallax-theme
items.title: Parallax theme
items.description: The Parallax palette: the base light and dark tokens, the eleven alternate palettes behind `data-theme`, and the Tailwind mappings for the token families shadcn does not ship — success, warning, info, the subtle family, and `--sidebar-outline`.
items.docs:
Two manual steps, because a registry item writes files and cannot patch the ones you already have.

1. Import the alternate palettes from your global stylesheet, after the Tailwind import: `@import "./themes.css";` — the `./` holds only when that stylesheet is a SIBLING of the `src/themes.css` this item just wrote. Resolve the path against the directory of the stylesheet itself: a SvelteKit scaffold puts it at `src/routes/layout.css`, which needs `../themes.css`. The `tailwind.css` entry in `components.json` names the real location.
2. Import the typeface the same way: `@import "@fontsource-variable/hanken-grotesk";`

A third applies only if your stylesheet was NOT created by `shadcn-svelte init` — check it for the `@layer base` block with `* { @apply border-border outline-ring/50; }` and for `@import "tw-animate-css";`, and add whichever is absent. Tailwind v4's preflight gives borders a width and a style but no colour, so without that rule every `border-*` utility falls back to `currentColor` and the hairlines wear the text colour instead. Nothing errors, the page renders, and only the borders are wrong.

`parallax` is the base — it IS the `:root` and `.dark` this item just wrote, so it has no `[data-theme]` block of its own. The other eleven answer to `data-theme` on `<html>`; `mode-watcher` owns that attribute and persists it under `mode-watcher-theme`.

items.name: parallax-appearance
items.title: Parallax appearance axes
items.description: The four appearance axes as persisted state: an inverted sidebar, an inverted header, a floating header and a header that hides on scroll down. Module-level runes that write attributes on `<html>`, plus the CSS those attributes key on.

items.name: parallax-appearance-controls
items.title: Parallax appearance controls
items.description: The two dropdown menus that drive the axes: one for the sidebar (inverted, floating) and one for the header (inverted, floating, hide on scroll). Put them on a settings page — or back in the header bar through `PageHeader`'s `controls` snippet — and the axes become user-facing.
items.docs: Both are icon-sized `DropdownMenu` triggers, for a settings page or a header's right-hand cluster. `parallax-shell`'s own header does not render them — its `controls` snippet is the light/dark toggle alone — so mount them where they belong in your app. They read and write the hooks directly, so they take no props and hold no state of their own.

items.name: parallax-swap
items.title: Swap
items.description: A two-state icon crossfade — the house primitive behind the light/dark toggle. Not in the official registry, which is why it ships from here.

items.name: parallax-shell
items.title: Parallax shell
items.description: The application shell: the sidebar (workspace switcher, two-shape navigation, user menu, icon rail, mobile drawer) and the page header bar (breadcrumb, search slot, light/dark toggle) — wired to the published appearance axes, taking their content as typed props.

items.name: parallax-skill
items.title: Parallax skill
items.description: The Agent Skill that teaches an AI assistant to use Parallax correctly: registry installation, shell composition, the token families, the palettes and the appearance axes, with the pitfalls spelled out. Installs into the project's `.claude/skills/parallax/`.
items.docs:
The skill is installed at `.claude/skills/parallax/` — commit it so the whole team's assistants share it, and start a fresh session if the assistant was already running when it landed. Invoke it explicitly with `/parallax`.

It teaches: discover before installing (components.json), install through the CLI, the two manual post-install steps, Svelte 5 runes only, semantic tokens (soft status fills pair with their own foregrounds), and the appearance axes through their hooks.

items.name: parallax-primitives
items.title: Parallax primitives
items.description: Shared infrastructure the house components compose: roving focus, form-control bridging, the TanStack table bridge, scroll position and the scroll parent, DOM-ordered collections. Installed automatically as a dependency; rarely asked for by name.

items.name: parallax-restyle
items.title: Parallax restyle
items.description: The Parallax shape for components this registry does not republish: css-only restyles of switch, checkbox, tooltip, inputs, native-select, select, sliders, sonner, navigation-menu, kbd, command and the tabs line variant, plus the global menu-shadow and dialog-scrim opinions. Install once beside parallax-theme.

items.name: parallax-accordion
items.title: Accordion
items.description: The house accordion: shadcn's API with a chevron pair that swaps on open, hairline seams between items, and link and paragraph spacing inside a panel.

items.name: parallax-action-bar
items.title: Action bar
items.description: The floating bulk-selection bar: a count, grouped actions, and an Escape that defers to open overlays.

items.name: parallax-alert
items.title: Alert
items.description: The house alert: shadcn's API plus an `Alert.Action` corner slot and the full status ramp — the soft `*-subtle` family and the `solid-*` fills.

items.name: parallax-alert-dialog
items.title: Alert dialog
items.description: The house alert dialog: a `Media` part for the leading illustration, size variants on the content, and Action/Cancel that take Button's own `variant` and `size` rather than wrapping a button in a button.

items.name: parallax-angle-slider
items.title: Angle slider
items.description: A circular slider for angles: drag the thumb round the dial, with keyboard steps and an optional range. Reach for it when the value is a direction rather than a position on a line.

items.name: parallax-autocomplete
items.title: Autocomplete
items.description: A text field that suggests as you type and still accepts what the list never offered — the free-text half of type-to-pick. Reach for Combobox instead when the answer must be one of the items.

items.name: parallax-avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: The house avatar: shadcn's API plus a size ramp, the hairline ring treatment, a status `Avatar.Badge` and `Avatar.Group` stacking.

items.name: parallax-badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: The house badge: shadcn's API plus the soft `*-subtle` variants for every status family, and the ghost and link variants.

items.name: parallax-badge-overflow
items.title: Badge overflow
items.description: A row of badges that measures its container and folds whatever does not fit into a `+N` indicator. Reach for it wherever a list of tags has to survive a narrow column.

items.name: parallax-banner
items.title: Banner
items.description: A full-width notification strip pinned to the top or bottom of the viewport, with a queue that shows one at a time in priority order. Reach for it when the message outranks the page — an Alert stays in the flow it was written into, and a toast clears itself.

items.name: parallax-breadcrumb
items.title: Breadcrumb
items.description: The house breadcrumb: shadcn's API with the theme's separator rhythm and muted trail, sized for the header bar the shell renders it in.

items.name: parallax-button
items.title: Button
items.description: The house button: shadcn's API on the --control-h-* ramp (24/32/40/48px), with xs/icon-xs sizes, the data-icon slots and the contextual solid and outline palettes.

items.name: parallax-button-group
items.title: Button group
items.description: The house button group: shadcn's API with the seam treatment that fuses a row or a column of controls into one shape, plus a `Text` part for inline labels.

items.name: parallax-calendar
items.title: Calendar
items.description: The house calendar: shadcn's API rebuilt on `--cell-size` and `--cell-radius`, so one month grid retunes for a card, a popover or a full page without forking the parts.

items.name: parallax-card
items.title: Card
items.description: The house card: shadcn's API plus a `size` prop that retunes `--card-spacing`, and the ring-drawn outline.

items.name: parallax-carousel
items.title: Carousel
items.description: The house carousel: shadcn's Embla wrapper with the previous and next controls rebuilt as round icon-sm Buttons on the house ramp.

items.name: parallax-chain-of-thought
items.title: Chain of thought
items.description: The steps a model took to an answer, as a collapsible trace: labelled steps with a status each, search-result chips and an optional image. Reach for it to show the WORK; Timeline is for events that happened to a system.

items.name: parallax-chart
items.title: Chart
items.description: The house chart frame: shadcn's LayerChart container, tooltip and legend on the theme's grid, axis and tooltip treatment, driven by a per-series colour config.

items.name: parallax-checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: The house checkbox: shadcn's API on a 4px-radius box with the theme's border, focus ring and indeterminate mark.

items.name: parallax-checkbox-group
items.title: Checkbox group
items.description: Several checkboxes as one value: a shared label, description and validation message, horizontal or vertical. Reach for it when the boxes answer one question rather than several.

items.name: parallax-circular-progress
items.title: Circular progress
items.description: A progress ring: a closed circle, 48px on a 4px stroke, determinate or indeterminate. Reach for Gauge when the arc itself carries meaning — the two share their geometry.

items.name: parallax-code-block
items.title: Code block
items.description: A copyable — and, given a filename, downloadable — code sample with a line-number gutter, a language selector and lightweight language-aware highlighting. Reach for it for an opaque string to read and copy; JSON viewer parses a live value instead.

items.name: parallax-code-highlighter
items.title: Code highlighter
items.description: A Shiki adapter for Code block's highlighter seam: real TextMate grammars for 32 languages, mapped onto the nine token kinds the block already paints, each grammar its own dynamic import. Mount `<CodeHighlighter.Root>` ONCE above the blocks that read it — it renders no element and reaches them through context. Reach for it over Code block's own tokenizer when a snippet spans lines (a block comment, a template literal, a docstring) or names a language outside the house fourteen; without it those blocks still render, uncoloured.
items.docs: Mount `<CodeHighlighter.Root>` ONCE, at the app root and above every code block: it renders no element, publishes itself on context, and a second one below the first only compiles a second engine. Nothing goes in your stylesheet — the ink is Code block's own `data-kind` spans over the theme tokens, and no Shiki theme is loaded at all. Each grammar is a `() => import("@shikijs/langs/<id>")`, so the languages become chunks of YOUR bundle and arrive on first use; only the adapter itself is in the initial payload.

items.name: parallax-color-picker
items.title: Color picker
items.description: A full colour picker: a saturation and brightness area, hue and alpha sliders, the native eyedropper, and per-channel fields in hex, rgb, hsl or hsb.

items.name: parallax-color-swatch
items.title: Color swatch
items.description: A single colour chip that renders transparency honestly, in five sizes — the building block of the picker's palette rows and of any legend that names a colour.

items.name: parallax-combobox
items.title: Combobox
items.description: A searchable select: a Command list inside a Popover, single, multiple, or multiple as chips. What it commits is always one of the items — reach for Autocomplete when the answer may be one the list never offered.

items.name: parallax-command
items.title: Command
items.description: The house command menu: shadcn's cmdk wrapper with the input rebuilt on Input group, a rounded popover ground and the selected-row treatment the palette uses.

items.name: parallax-compare-slider
items.title: Compare slider
items.description: Two versions of one image and a divider that wipes between them, by pointer, by touch or from the keyboard.

items.name: parallax-confirmation
items.title: Confirmation
items.description: The approval gate on a tool call: the request while a decision is open, then the accepted or rejected receipt, painted from the status ramp. Renders nothing until there is a decision to show.

items.name: parallax-context-menu
items.title: Context menu
items.description: The house context menu: shadcn's API with the flat row treatment, ring-drawn popovers and an RTL-aware submenu chevron.

items.name: parallax-context-usage
items.title: Context usage
items.description: How much of a model's context window a conversation has used — a ring in the composer, a hover card of token counts and, when the caller supplies one, the cost. Numbers and cost are the caller's; the component only formats them.

items.name: parallax-conversation
items.title: Conversation
items.description: The transcript viewport: sticks to the bottom while a reply streams, offers a scroll-to-bottom button once the reader has scrolled away, an empty state, and a Markdown download of the whole exchange.

items.name: parallax-copy-button
items.title: Copy button
items.description: A button that writes text to the clipboard and swaps its icon for a tick — once the write has actually resolved. The swap is a Svelte transition, with no animation library.

items.name: parallax-cropper
items.title: Cropper
items.description: An image and video crop surface: drag, wheel zoom, pinch-zoom-rotate and arrow-key nudging, rectangular or round.

items.name: parallax-data-grid
items.title: Data grid
items.description: The spreadsheet: virtualized rows, cell-addressed keyboard navigation, in-place editors per cell variant, its own ARIA grid markup.

items.name: parallax-data-table
items.title: Data table
items.description: The TanStack-driven table engine: createDataTable state in runes, Toolbar with meta-driven filters, ColumnHeader, FlexRender, Pagination. The motor behind every list page in the gallery.

items.name: parallax-date-selector
items.title: Date selector
items.description: One control for a day, a month, a quarter, a half-year or a year, behind an is/before/after/between operator, with a free-text input that parses all of them.

items.name: parallax-dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: The house dialog: shadcn's API with the close control rebuilt as a ghost icon Button, on the popover ground the theme's overlays share.

items.name: parallax-direction-provider
items.title: Direction provider
items.description: The RTL/LTR provider. Where upstream renders no DOM and asks each consumer to forward `dir` itself, this renders a `display: contents` wrapper, so the real attribute reaches the subtree and descendants flip without opting in.

items.name: parallax-drawer
items.title: Drawer
items.description: The house drawer: shadcn's Vaul wrapper on the popover ground, with the drag handle and edge treatment the mobile sidebar uses.

items.name: parallax-dropdown-menu
items.title: Dropdown menu
items.description: The house dropdown menu: shadcn's API with the flat row treatment, ring-drawn popovers and check and radio indicators on the trailing edge.

items.name: parallax-editable
items.title: Editable
items.description: Text that becomes an input in place: a trigger, a preview, an input and a submit/cancel toolbar over one bindable value. Reach for it in a table cell or a heading where a whole form would be too much furniture.

items.name: parallax-empty
items.title: Empty
items.description: The house empty state: shadcn's API with the media tile, heading and description treatment every placeholder in the gallery shares.

items.name: parallax-event-calendar
items.title: Event calendar
items.description: A full scheduling surface: month, week, day, N-day, agenda and resource views over one event model, with time zones, recurrence, localisation and an imperative API.

items.name: parallax-field
items.title: Field
items.description: The house field: shadcn's form-layout primitive carrying the label, description and error rhythm every form in this theme is built from, including the horizontal and fieldset arrangements.

items.name: parallax-filters
items.title: Filters
items.description: The filter row as state: a filter is a chip of field, operator and value, and the row of them is a value the page owns. Reach for it when a list needs more than a search box.

items.name: parallax-fps
items.title: Fps
items.description: A frames-per-second counter, for watching whether an interaction still runs at frame rate.

items.name: parallax-frame
items.title: Frame
items.description: A presentational panel family: a bordered tray whose header, panels and footer share one spacing ladder and one radius, with panels separated, fused into a stacked run, or pulled flush to the edge.

items.name: parallax-gauge
items.title: Gauge
items.description: A circular meter over a configurable arc — a dial, a segment, a sweep short of a full turn — with an indeterminate state. Reach for Circular progress when a closed ring is all you need.

items.name: parallax-hover-card
items.title: Hover card
items.description: The house hover card: shadcn's API on the theme's popover ground, ring-drawn rather than shadowed.

items.name: parallax-icon-stack
items.title: Icon stack
items.description: A layered isometric mark framing a single icon — the illustration an empty state or a feature card leads with, tinted from the surrounding text colour.

items.name: parallax-icon-tile
items.title: Icon tile
items.description: A small framed container for one icon — the mark that leads a list row, a feature card or an empty state — in five surfaces, five sizes and two corner treatments.

items.name: parallax-input
items.title: Input
items.description: The house input: shadcn's API at the theme's height, padding and focus ring, so a field and a default button share a line.

items.name: parallax-input-group
items.title: Input group
items.description: The house input group: shadcn's API with addons on either side of the control or above and below it, and an `xs` button size for the controls that sit inside one.

items.name: parallax-input-otp
items.title: Input otp
items.description: A segmented one-time-code field, rebuilt on its own state module and provider: a slot per character, groups split by separators, and one hidden input so paste and autofill keep working.

items.name: parallax-item
items.title: Item
items.description: The house item row: shadcn's title/description/action row with the `xs` and `sm` sizes and the media slot the gallery's list rows use. For the framed container drawn around a run of them, see the List group page.

items.name: parallax-json-viewer
items.title: Json viewer
items.description: A collapsible JSON tree coloured by runtime type, with expand and collapse, copy, and array truncation. Reach for Code block when the payload is an opaque sample rather than a tree to navigate.

items.name: parallax-kanban
items.title: Kanban
items.description: A drag-and-drop board: reorder inside a column, move between columns, reorder the columns themselves — with a pointer, with touch, or from the keyboard alone.

items.name: parallax-kbd
items.title: Kbd
items.description: The house keyboard key: shadcn's API as the theme's muted chip, sized to sit inside an input group or a menu row.

items.name: parallax-key-value
items.title: Key value
items.description: A dynamic list of key/value pairs with paste support and per-row validation — headers, environment variables, metadata a user types.

items.name: parallax-language-selector
items.title: Language selector
items.description: A dialog that switches the active locale. The catalog is data the caller supplies and the component moves a code: it translates nothing.

items.name: parallax-listbox
items.title: Listbox
items.description: An always-visible option list with the WAI-ARIA keyboard model and typeahead, single or multiple, as a column or a grid. Reach for it when the options should not be hidden behind a trigger.

items.name: parallax-loader
items.title: Loader
items.description: 128 loaders behind one API, with a shared reduced-motion answer: moving parts stop, the loader breathes.

items.name: parallax-marquee
items.title: Marquee
items.description: Content that scrolls continuously, horizontally or vertically — pausing on hover and on focus, mirroring under RTL, and holding still for reduced motion.

items.name: parallax-mask-input
items.title: Mask input
items.description: An input that formats what you type against a pattern — a phone number, a date, a card, a currency amount — and keeps the caret where you left it.

items.name: parallax-masonry
items.title: Masonry
items.description: A masonry grid: a column count that answers the breakpoint, and items placed by measured height rather than by row.

items.name: parallax-media-player
items.title: Media player
items.description: A full video and audio player: custom controls, chapters, captions, playback rate and the complete keyboard shortcut set.

items.name: parallax-mention
items.title: Mention
items.description: A text field that suggests and inserts mentions when a trigger character is typed at a word boundary. The popup follows the caret, and each inserted mention behaves as one atomic unit of text.

items.name: parallax-menubar
items.title: Menubar
items.description: The house menubar: shadcn's API with the flat row treatment, ring-drawn popovers and indicators on the leading edge.

items.name: parallax-message
items.title: Message
items.description: One turn of a chat — a user bubble or an assistant answer — with a Markdown response rendered through svelte-streamdown, actions, a toolbar, and a pager for walking the alternatives a regenerate leaves behind. Installing it brings svelte-streamdown and needs one `@source` line in the stylesheet.
items.docs: Markdown renders through svelte-streamdown, whose classes live in node_modules: add `@source "../node_modules/svelte-streamdown/**/*";` next to the imports of your global stylesheet (`../../node_modules/…` from src/routes/layout.css). Without it answers render unstyled and nothing errors.

items.name: parallax-model-selector
items.title: Model selector
items.description: A command palette for choosing a model: searchable groups per provider, provider logos, a name slot. Chosen values are the caller's; the component only presents the list.

items.name: parallax-native-select
items.title: Native select
items.description: The house native select: the browser's own dropdown at the theme's field height, with a `sm` or `default` size stamped as `data-size`.

items.name: parallax-navigation-menu
items.title: Navigation menu
items.description: The house navigation menu: shadcn's API with the theme's trigger, link and viewport treatment, and `navigationMenuTriggerStyle` exported for the links that are not triggers.

items.name: parallax-number-field
items.title: Number field
items.description: A numeric input with spinner buttons, press-and-hold repeat, keyboard stepping and a drag-to-scrub label.

items.name: parallax-pagination
items.title: Pagination
items.description: The house pagination: shadcn's API with the page links drawn by `buttonVariants` at any Button size, so a pager matches the controls beside it.

items.name: parallax-partition-bar
items.title: Partition bar
items.description: A total split into labelled parts: one bar per part, sized by its share, with its name and measurement underneath.

items.name: parallax-pending
items.title: Pending
items.description: A wrapper that marks anything as pending: interactions off, keyboard focus kept, and the right ARIA state for buttons, forms, links and switches.

items.name: parallax-phone-input
items.title: Phone input
items.description: A phone field with country detection and international formatting, built on the mask input.

items.name: parallax-popover
items.title: Popover
items.description: The house popover: shadcn's API plus `Header`, `Title` and `Description` parts, so a popover with a heading is composed rather than hand-laid.

items.name: parallax-progress
items.title: Progress
items.description: The house progress bar: shadcn's API as a slim rounded track on the muted ground.

items.name: parallax-prompt-input
items.title: Prompt input
items.description: The composer: an auto-growing textarea that submits on Enter, a header and footer for tools, borderless selects, and a submit button that becomes a stop button while a reply is in flight. Files attach from its action menu, a drop or a paste, validated against `accept`, `maxFiles` and `maxFileSize`.

items.name: parallax-qr-code
items.title: Qr code
items.description: A QR code you compose: the same value rendered as SVG, canvas or image, with a centre overlay, a loading skeleton and a download control.

items.name: parallax-question
items.title: Question
items.description: A clarifying question from the model, as a form: single or multiple choice, a free-text answer, and a submit that stays disabled until there is a response. Its shape is the AskUserQuestion tool call.

items.name: parallax-radio-group
items.title: Radio group
items.description: The house radio group: shadcn's API with the theme's ring, dot indicator and row rhythm.

items.name: parallax-range-calendar
items.title: Range calendar
items.description: The house range calendar: shadcn's API plus the `rangeCalendar`, `rangeCalendarFlush` and `rangeDay` class recipes, so a range picker reads the same in a card, in a popover, or flush to a panel edge.

items.name: parallax-rating
items.title: Rating
items.description: A star rating that displays whole, half and fractional scores, and — when editable — collects one by mouse or keyboard.

items.name: parallax-reasoning
items.title: Reasoning
items.description: The model's reasoning summary in a collapsible panel that opens while it streams, reports how long the thinking took, and closes itself once the answer starts. Reach for it over Collapsible when the content is a thought, not a section.

items.name: parallax-relative-time-card
items.title: Relative time card
items.description: A hover card that shows a moment as relative time, with the absolute time and its zone underneath.

items.name: parallax-resizable
items.title: Resizable
items.description: The house resizable panes: shadcn's API with the hairline handle and grip the theme's split layouts use.

items.name: parallax-responsive-dialog
items.title: Responsive dialog
items.description: One dialog that renders as a centred modal above the breakpoint and a bottom drawer below it — and swaps between them without closing.

items.name: parallax-scroll-area
items.title: Scroll area
items.description: The house scroll area: shadcn's API with the overlay scrollbar the theme paints. Reach for Scroller instead when native scrolling should stay and only the edge cues are wanted.

items.name: parallax-scroll-spy
items.title: Scroll spy
items.description: Navigation links that track scroll position and scroll to their section on click, nested sections included.

items.name: parallax-scroller
items.title: Scroller
items.description: A scroll container that keeps the browser's own scrollbar and fades the edges where content continues, with optional buttons that scroll on press, hover or click. Where Scroll area replaces the scrollbar, this only layers affordances on top of it.

items.name: parallax-segmented-input
items.title: Segmented input
items.description: Connected inputs that read as one segmented control, with focus and typing moving between the segments as they fill and empty.

items.name: parallax-select
items.title: Select
items.description: The house select: shadcn's API at the theme's field height, with the boxed trigger, ring-drawn content and scroll buttons on the popover ground.

items.name: parallax-selection-toolbar
items.title: Selection toolbar
items.description: A floating toolbar that appears over a text selection, carrying formatting and utility actions.

items.name: parallax-separator
items.title: Separator
items.description: The house separator: shadcn's API on the theme's border token, a hairline in both orientations.

items.name: parallax-shake
items.title: Shake
items.description: A wrapper that replays a perspective wobble whenever a signal changes — the wrong-password nudge.

items.name: parallax-sheet
items.title: Sheet
items.description: The house sheet: shadcn's edge panel with the close control rebuilt as a ghost icon Button, and a `showCloseButton` for the panels that own their own.

items.name: parallax-sidebar
items.title: Sidebar
items.description: The sidebar primitive the application shell is built on — provider, rail, menu, sub-menu and mobile drawer — retuned to the theme's rhythm and its sidebar tokens. `parallax-shell` installs it already wired.

items.name: parallax-skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: The house skeleton: shadcn's pulsing placeholder on the muted ground rather than the accent one.

items.name: parallax-slider
items.title: Slider
items.description: The house slider: shadcn's API with the pale thumb and focus ring the theme's controls share, horizontal or vertical.

items.name: parallax-sortable
items.title: Sortable
items.description: Drag-and-drop reordering for a list or a grid, operable with a pointer, with touch and from the keyboard alone. Kanban composes it.

items.name: parallax-speed-dial
items.title: Speed dial
items.description: A floating action button that fans a set of labelled actions out when it is triggered.

items.name: parallax-spinner
items.title: Spinner
items.description: The house spinner: shadcn's loading mark with `role` and `aria-label` overridable, and the foreign icon-library props (`name`, `color`, `stroke`) normalised so another icon set can stand in.

items.name: parallax-status
items.title: Status
items.description: A status indicator: a dot with an animated ping and the colour families, for system state, presence and service health.

items.name: parallax-status-monitor
items.title: Status monitor
items.description: The uptime strip from a public status page: one bar per period, coloured by state, with a tooltip per bar.

items.name: parallax-stepper
items.title: Stepper
items.description: A multi-step flow with visible progress: a list of steps with indicator, title, description and separator, horizontal or vertical, each carrying its own state.

items.name: parallax-suggestion
items.title: Suggestion
items.description: A row of follow-up prompts as pill buttons, scrolling sideways when they overflow. Each pill hands its text to the caller; reach for Badge when the chips are labels rather than actions.

items.name: parallax-switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: The house switch: shadcn's API with the theme's track and thumb, stamped `data-size` so the control ramp reaches it.

items.name: parallax-table
items.title: Table
items.description: The house table: shadcn's API plus the three-tier density axis (data-density retunes row/head/cell tokens; tiers are floors, not clamps).

items.name: parallax-tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: The house tabs: shadcn's API plus the `line` list variant and its `sm` size, both stamped as `data-*` so `app.css` owns the look.

items.name: parallax-tags-input
items.title: Tags input
items.description: Free-text values entered as removable chips, with paste, split-on-delimiter, edit in place and per-tag validation.

items.name: parallax-task
items.title: Task
items.description: A model's todo item as a collapsible: a title, sub-items and file chips, open by default so progress reads at a glance.

items.name: parallax-text-gradient
items.title: Text gradient
items.description: A highlight that sweeps through text — the label that says a machine is still working.

items.name: parallax-textarea
items.title: Textarea
items.description: The house textarea: shadcn's API at the theme's padding and focus ring, so it matches the fields beside it.

items.name: parallax-timeline
items.title: Timeline
items.description: A chronological list of events: vertical or horizontal, an alternating variant, RTL support, and completed/active/pending states.

items.name: parallax-toggle
items.title: Toggle
items.description: The house toggle: shadcn's API on the --control-h-* ramp with the data-icon slots, so a toggle and a button share a line.

items.name: parallax-toggle-group
items.title: Toggle group
items.description: The house toggle group: shadcn's API with a `spacing` axis — fused into one shape, or spaced apart — and an orientation.

items.name: parallax-tool
items.title: Tool
items.description: One tool call as a card: name, a status badge from the seven AI SDK states, the parameters it was called with and the result it returned — structured payloads through JSON viewer, text through code block.

items.name: parallax-tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: The house tooltip: shadcn's API on the inverted foreground ground, with the arrow the theme draws.

items.name: parallax-tour
items.title: Tour
items.description: A guided tour: highlight an element, step through the instructions, and teach a screen the first time somebody sees it.

items.name: parallax-tree
items.title: Tree
items.description: A multi-level tree view with expand and collapse, selection, and the WAI-ARIA keyboard model.
